scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix api-service" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,web,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix api-service" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix api-service
